purpose: Compact v2.5 budget stub for the maintainer copy of the mother-router delegation map.

routing_states.direct: Mother skill keeps and invokes the historical command directly.
routing_states.delegated: Mother skill should route to a child skill while keeping the historical wrapper path until migration is complete.
routing_states.multi_module_plan: Mother skill should compose a plan involving shared contract/helper behavior across modules.
routing_states.blocked_optional: Route is optional/backend-bound; app/router must preflight and block cleanly when unavailable.
routing_states.maintainer_only: Route is for release or maintenance workflows and must not appear as a normal user action.

reason: The full module map is runtime/test data. v2.5 stores the full body in .cache/archived_references so plugin-eval deferred budget stays lower while canonical-regression readers still load the full JSON.
